claims.claim: Motivational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 titles span business (Small Business Big Money, This Is Marketing), relationship (Seven Principles for Making Marriage Work, Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage), and motivational/self-development (How to Win Friends, The Compound Effect, How Successful People Think) genres, matching the claim.

risks.risk: Interior page condition (markings, missing pages, yellowing, water damage) cannot be assessed from cover-only photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or a short video flipping through pages of each book, especially spine and inner margins.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: assume heavy wear/foxing on all interior pages.

risks.risk: Whether all 20 books are sold as a single lot or priced/sold individually is unclear.
risks.proof: Seller statement or listing text explicitly confirming lot-only sale or per-book pricing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single bulk lot at the lowest aggregate value, not as 20 individually priced items.

risks.risk: Edition or printing year of each title is unknown, which affects value for collectible or specific editions.
risks.proof: Photo of the copyright/edition page for each book.
risks.if_unproven: Price as common/generic paperback edition, lowest typical market value.

risks.risk: Completeness of the set as advertised vs. what will actually be delivered (seller could substitute or withhold a title).
risks.proof: A video showing the seller bagging/packing the exact 20 books shown, matching spines to the photos.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible shortfall; treat as if 1-2 books may be missing.

risks.risk: Spine wear, torn covers, or damage from angles not shown (back cover, spine edge, bottom of stack).
risks.proof: Additional photos of each book's spine and back cover, plus a close-up of the stack from a side angle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as moderately used condition (visible wear), not as new or near-new.

proof_requests: Video flipping through pages of each book showing interior condition
Close-up of each book's copyright/edition page
Video of seller packing the exact 20 books shown, matching spines to photos
Photos of spines and back covers of all books
Confirmation whether sold as one lot or individually
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a set of 20 self-help/business/relationship/finance books matching the seller's description, so it can be priced at worst-case condition and completeness pending further proof.
